tasks.title: Finalize MVP specification and operator flow
acceptance: Review the draft architecture and record decisions for unknown triage facts, conflicting overrides, ALS shortage and hard versus soft reserve rules.
Define screen states and acceptance scenarios for intake, plan diff, approval, override and replay.
Publish entity/event/API examples with coordinate, time, capacity, idempotency and stale-version semantics. Codex reviews implementation feasibility.

tasks.title: Create runnable scaffold and canonical contracts
acceptance: Create Python 3.12 FastAPI and React/TypeScript/Vite apps with pinned lockfiles and exact setup commands.
Implement canonical models and generate JSON Schema/OpenAPI and TypeScript consumers with valid/invalid contract tests.
Add backend lint/type/test and frontend lint/type/test/build CI jobs; health endpoint and frontend smoke check pass from a clean install.

tasks.title: Build event store and synthetic world state
acceptance: Append idempotent events transactionally and project incidents, fleet, facilities, flood state and plan versions.
Provide state snapshot, event replay, WebSocket sequence and reconnect protocol plus seeded synthetic Bengaluru data.
Test duplicate commands, concurrent version checks, restart/replay equivalence and simulation reset boundaries.

tasks.title: Build operator console against contract mocks
acceptance: Implement map, incident queue, fleet, triage facts, plan diff, policy flags and approval/override screens using schema-valid mocks.
Cover keyboard interaction, loading/empty/error/disconnected states and clear proposed versus approved simulation status.
Add UI interaction tests and screenshots at desktop and narrow widths; show required map attribution.

tasks.title: Implement assessment and constrained allocation
acceptance: Implement versioned assessment/needs rules, waiting-age priority and integer-scaled CP-SAT objectives.
Enforce membership, availability, resource type, one task per unit, route reachability, facility capacity and locks; retain explicit unmet demand.
Test shortage, zero fleet, equal-cost ties, infeasible overrides, unavailable locked units and solver timeout; return structured reasons and solver status.

tasks.title: Implement typed text intake and safe explanations
acceptance: Implement template/rule adapters and an optional Gemini adapter behind merged interfaces; no API key required for the default demo.
Extract yes/no/unknown facts with evidence, ask targeted questions and escalate human requests/critical uncertainty independent of model success.
Validate schema, timeouts and prompt-injection cases; derive explanations only from validated facts. Add held-out English/Hindi/Hinglish examples with no silent critical-to-no conversions.

tasks.title: Implement flood-aware routing and capacity inputs
acceptance: Build fixture and ORS Directions adapters with explicit seconds/metres, bounded calls and cache invalidation by flood version.
Check routes against closure polygons and facility reachability; never treat no-route or provider failure as an ordinary road ETA.
Test polygon crossings, isolated incidents/facilities, stale cache, tow-to-emergency upgrade inputs and boat eligibility.

tasks.title: Wire replanning policy gate and simulated dispatch
acceptance: Connect event changes through impact analysis, locks, routes, allocation, invariant validation and versioned plan diffs.
Bind approve/override to plan and event version in a transaction; implement idempotent simulated outbox and watchdog feedback.
Test breakdown plus new critical incident, late approvals, conflicting overrides, duplicate dispatch, replay without resend and visible unmet ALS/reserve flags.

tasks.title: Integrate console and intake with the live backend
acceptance: Replace screen mocks with the real API, intake and WebSocket stream using generated types.
Demonstrate report to plan to operator decision to simulated dispatch; why-not results reference actual solver facts.
Add end-to-end tests for reconnect/sequence gaps, stale approvals, model failure and the breakdown scenario. Coordinate backend fixes with Codex.

tasks.title: Add Medical ID duplicate reports and scenario runner
acceptance: Implement synthetic opt-in profiles with caller-is-patient check, active-incident access and audited reads; separate profiles from immutable event payloads.
Add spatial/time duplicate candidate blocking and optional E5 similarity while preserving conflict/provenance and distinct incidents.
Implement deterministic T+0/T+2/T+5/T+10 scenario runner, hospital matching and simulated pre-alerts; wire required UI controls after Claude lane is merged.

tasks.title: Run adversarial review and benchmark evaluation
acceptance: Independently run and record 100 seeded scenarios against a nearest eligible available-unit baseline with identical constraints.
Report weighted response time, critical-under-eight-minute share, unmet needs, reassignments, uncovered zones and p50/p95 replanning latency with machine/commit metadata.
Run held-out triage tests and approval/replay/privacy failure cases; deliver reproducible prioritized findings for Codex. Complete the review task even if it finds defects; CC-12 is the repair gate.

tasks.title: Resolve review findings and package the demo
acceptance: Fix all release-blocking CC-11 findings with regression coverage; Claude verifies repairs at the final commit.
Provide clean-machine setup and run instructions, persistent data behavior, simulated dispatch boundaries and no-key offline fixtures.
Pass full application CI and the scripted scenario, document remaining limitations and measured performance. No public deployment is required.

tasks.title: Prepare demo narrative and release acceptance
acceptance: Write a timed presentation script showing T+0 through T+10, plan diff, approval/override and offline fallback.
Prepare claims/evidence table, screenshots and fallback runbook; distinguish measured outcomes from hypotheses.
User can reproduce the complete demo from documented commands and decides whether to publish/deploy.

tasks.title: Evaluate optional Laya and voice extensions
acceptance: Only after core acceptance: pin Laya checkpoint/license, measure hardware latency, evaluate held-out triage recall/calibration and compare to baseline.
If time permits, benchmark multilingual Whisper/browser speech with text fallback; select a local LLM only after memory/latency checks.
Keep new adapters optional and disabled by default until tests justify adoption; record negative results without blocking the completed core demo.
